name: Conspiracies of the Heart
source: You're a tough-talking, quick-witted community officer committed to protecting others, but what happens when the roles get reversed? After a bizarre chain of events kicks off leading to your parents' disappearance, three enigmatic men waltz into your life, eager to avenge you. As you stumble across strange conspiracies and salvage phantom memories, it’s clear those closest to you have a past they're unwilling to reveal. At the end of the day, who can your heart really trust?
translation: 你是一名說話強硬、反應敏捷的社區警員，一心保護他人，可當雙方角色對調，又會怎樣？一連串離奇事件導致父母失蹤，三位神秘男子隨即闖入你的人生，積極地想替你復仇。當你偶然撞見古怪的陰謀，拾回如幻影般的記憶時，你漸漸明白，最親近的人，都有著不願揭露的過去。到頭來，你的心究竟能相信誰？
